title: Bridging the Topological Divide: Dual-Branch Graph Distillation with Semantic Priors for Robust Cold-Start Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.19578v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Graph Collaborative Filtering models have achieved remarkable success in recommendation systems. However, they inherently suffer from a catastrophic representation collapse in strict cold-start scenarios due to the topological isolation of unobserved items. While integrating multi-modal semantic features offers a potential remedy, directly mapping isolated semantic attributes into a globally topology-driven collaborative space frequently precipitates representation degradation and optimization conflicts. To bridge this fundamental structural divide, we propose DualGCN, an innovative Dual-Branch Graph Knowledge Distillation Framework. Operating under a decoupled two-stage training paradigm, DualGCN first constructs a robust collaborative teacher network where item representations are anchored by a topology-smoothed semantic prior, effectively reshaping the latent manifold. translated_title: 跨越拓扑鸿沟：基于语义先验的双分支图蒸馏实现鲁棒冷启动推荐
translated_abstract: 图协同过滤模型在推荐系统中取得了显著的成功。然而，由于未观测物品的拓扑隔离性，这些模型在严格的冷启动场景中固有地遭受灾难性的表示坍塌问题。虽然整合多模态语义特征提供了一种潜在的补救方案，但将孤立的语义属性直接映射到全局拓扑驱动的协同空间中，往往会引发表示退化和优化冲突。为了弥合这一根本性的结构鸿沟，我们提出了DualGCN——一个创新的双分支图知识蒸馏框架。DualGCN在解耦的两阶段训练范式下运行：首先构建一个鲁棒的协同教师网络，其中物品表示由拓扑平滑的语义先验锚定，有效重塑了潜在流形；随后，语义学生分支采用残差映射（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出DualGCN双分支图知识蒸馏框架，通过拓扑平滑的语义先验锚定教师网络的物品表示，并以解耦的两阶段训练将知识蒸馏给语义学生分支，从而弥合语义空间与协同空间之间的拓扑鸿沟，解决冷启动推荐中的表示坍塌问题。
en_tdlr: DualGCN, a dual-branch graph knowledge distillation framework, bridges the topological divide between semantic and collaborative spaces by anchoring teacher item representations with topology-smoothed semantic priors, resolving representation collapse in cold-start recommendation.
